llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must explicitly set Home as the initial tab route.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No `initialRouteName` prop is set on `Tab.Navigator`, so the initial tab is implicit (first screen) rather than explicitly declared.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The code uses the dynamic API (`NavigationContainer` + `Tab.Navigator` JSX) instead of the static API (`createBottomTabNavigator({ screens: ... })` + `createStaticNavigation(...)`).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define three bottom tab routes named Home, Search, Profile using `createBottomTabNavigator` from `@react-navigation/bottom-tabs`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Three `Tab.Screen` components named Home, Search, and Profile are defined using `createBottomTabNavigator` from `@react-navigation/bottom-tabs`.
